{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = df_clean[
    (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Calculate conversion rate
num_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
total = len(filtered_df)
conversion_rate = num_converted / total

# Print the exact numbers that will be used in evidence
print(total)
print(num_converted)
print(conversion_rate)"}
